comment: “Product” is defined as a coherent offering bundling services and data, with a digital health wallet as the example. Elsewhere, “product” predominantly refers to health commodities managed by the Product Registry. Using the same term for two distinct concepts may confuse readers.

public.text: “Product” is defined as a coherent offering bundling services and data, with a digital health wallet as the example. Elsewhere, “product” predominantly refers to health commodities managed by the Product Registry. Using the same term for two distinct concepts may confuse readers.
public.suggestedRevision: Label the modelling concept as ArchiMate Product wherever it is used, and clarify that it is distinct from a medicine, device, vaccine, or commodity represented in the Product Registry.
